Complete [[Destruction's Depths]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Reclaim the [[Asura Gate]] to the [[Central Transfer Chamber]] from the [[Destroyers]] in the [[Depths of Tyria]].
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 5,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,000 [[Gold]]
* 2,500 [[Deldrimor rank|Dwarf reputation points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 40 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
As per the [[Destruction's Depths#Walkthrough|Destruction's Depths]] quest.
